title: Jesse and Cookies
description: Jesse loves cookies and wants the sweetness of some cookies to be greater than a given value k. To do this, two cookies with the least sweetness are repeatedly mixed. This creates a special combined cookie with sweetness equal to (1 * least sweet cookie) + (2 * second least sweet cookie). This occurs until all the cookies have a sweetness greater than or equal to k. Given the sweetness of a number of cookies, determine the minimum number of operations required. If it is not possible, return -1.
input_format: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and k, the number of cookies and the minimum required sweetness respectively. The next line contains n space-separated integers, A[i], representing the sweetness of each cookie.
output_format: Print the minimum number of operations required to increase the sweetness of all cookies to at least k. If it is not possible, print -1.
